_comment: Generated by scripts/gen-tool-catalog.ts — do not edit by hand. Run `pnpm run gen-tool-catalog` to regenerate. Lite tool schemas projection: exactly the shipped tools whose §32 declaration carries supportsLite: true, joined with the model-facing schemas the same boot harvested through ctx.tools.schemas() — a Lite request face mounts these name/description/parameters rows as its tools array. The generator fails on any supportsLite declaration without a harvestable schema instead of dropping the tool. Dynamically registered tools (MCP servers, sandbox packages) are absent.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Provide 1–4 queries in the required queries array. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: Required search queries; accepts 1–4 items and merges their results.
